items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Kenny Clarke) does not mention Evelyn directly; the mention is part of a story about 'he' (likely a brother or associate) worrying about 'Evelyn and the baby'.

ctx.x: And talk with me. So, well, he stayed there about a couple of weeks, and then he became homesick. He said, 'I want to go back and see what Evelyn is doing. I'm kind of worried. Evelyn and the baby are alone.' So he went back to Pittsburgh, and I stayed in Cincinnati, oh, quite a while, I stayed out there about six months. And Andy Kirk's band --
I've got to stop you. We've got to go back, because we got onto your brother but we left you at the age of 14 --
